TITLE: Iran's top diplomat says a lack of trust is impeding talks to end war with the US
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-15T10:11Z (updated 2026-05-16T05:46Z — Saturday)
AUTHORS: Sheikh Saaliq, Adam Schreck (Associated Press, New Delhi)
(Search snippet content — direct AP headline + lede; AP's own reporting language)

LEDE (per AP article):
Iran's foreign minister says that a lack of trust remains the biggest obstacle in negotiations to end the war with the U.S.

CONTEXT:
Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend the expiring Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire for another 45 days to allow for negotiations on a broader peace agreement.

The article tags Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi (speaking at the BRICS Foreign Ministers meeting in New Delhi), Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, UAE leader Khaled bin Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Xi Jinping, Yechiel Leiter, and Tahir Andrabi.
